newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-North Flinders Q2 production flat.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-North Flinders Q2 production flat.

text.p: North Flinders Mines Ltd said on Thursday its mine production for the December quarter was flat but gold resources rose by 10 percent to 3.9 million ounces.

In its quarterly report, North Flinders said quarterly production was 56,342 ounces, compared with 56,161 in the September quarter. Total cash cost was A$273 per ounce, down from A$287, although higher than previously stated due to the adoption of the North American Gold Institute standard which treats royalties as a cash cost, its quarterly report said.
Mill throughput was seven percent lower due to mill trials of Callie underground ore, offset by four percent higher head grade and three percent recovery, the company said.

North Flinders said significant changes from its previous resource inventory included an indicated resource of 840,000 tonnes at 2.6 grams per tonne at the Minotaur deposit, and a 60 percent rise to 4.1 million tonnes at 2.6 g/t at Oberon.

Total gold sales for the quarter were flat at 56,734 ounces, compared to 56,289 ounces, at an average realised A$580 per ounce, up from A$572 per ounce, with the average spot price for the period at A$473 per ounce, it said.
A total of 613,800 ounces of gold was hedged at an average A$658 per ounce, North Flinders said.
North Flinders said the Callie Wilson Shoot at Dead Bullock Soak now had been shown to extend for about 250 metres east of and 200 metres below the limit of resources.
North Flinders is 75 percent owned by Normandy Mining Ltd.
